Expected behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
Actual behavior
A clear and concise description of what actually happened.
Screenshots / Recordings
If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain the problem.
Logs / Error Messages
If applicable, include relevant console errors, terminal output, stack traces, or other error messages.
Device Information
Device: [e.g. Windows PC, Android phone, iPhone]
OS: [e.g. Windows 11, Android 16, Ubuntu 24.04, iOS]
Browser Information
Browser: [e.g. Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari]
Version: [e.g. 140]
Additional context
Add any other context about the problem here.
Checklist
1.I have searched existing issues to make sure this bug has not already been reported.
2.I have provided enough information to reproduce the problem.
3.I have removed any private information, API keys, passwords, or other secrets from my report.
